history.p: The motet was apparently composed for a wedding in Leipzig in 1846. It became extremely popular with slightly different texts and was also translated into Danish.

physDesc.physMedium: 1 bifolio. Written in ink. Paper: 12 staves. Text in German with Danish translation ("Du Kjærlighedens Ophav Gud!") added in pencil by Gade. At the end of the music on p. 4 Gade has added: "Dec. 1846 / Leipzig / für eine Traung gemacht."
